question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

License granted to an individual or group to market a company's goods or services in a particular territory
solution:
The correct answer is "**Franchise**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word "franchise" can replace the given phrase.
 
• **A franchise is a license granted to an individual or group to market a company's goods or services in a particular territory.**(विशेष अधिकार)
 
• The franchisee pays a fee to the franchisor for the right to use their business model and brand name.
 
 
• Example: They just opened a new fast-food franchise.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Branding" refers to the process of creating a distinctive name and image for a product or company.
 
• "Marketing" involves promoting and selling products or services.(विपणन)
 
• "Monopoly" refers to a situation in which a single company or group has control over a particular market or industry.(एकाधिकार)
